"A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Grace asks "Say that again — slower." Amina breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
